text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap!

Th-thank you so much! Be on the
lookout for
more Falco!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон finishes first in her debut
race and
manages to secure center stage
for the winning
concert.
Thanks...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
...It just doesn't feel real. I can hardly
believe it.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I'm super happy I got to sing in front of
everyone.
It felt great to have the
spotlight on me.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: But... that's not all.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
The lights the audience was waving...
They were
all for me.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Their cheers, their gazes... they were all
honed in
on center stage—on me.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
It was... amazing. Winning concerts are
amazing.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: And being center stage is so much fun!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list: It'll be even more exciting on a bigger stage.

text_block_list.text:
You're right! My debut concert was
already so
much fun!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I wanna perform on an even bigger
stage! I wanna
be a top Umadol!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Her first time center stage seems to have

strengthened her resolve to reach the
top.
Yeah!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон is off to a great start and
seems full
of enthusiasm while we discuss
our path moving
forward.

I've got a question for you! What's the
first thing
a freshly-debuted Umadol has
to do?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Nope! Well, actually, you're not entirely
wrong!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
But Umadols are all about practical
experience!
I've gotta get more fans by
putting on real
concerts! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I wanna run tons of races and take
center stage a
bunch of times!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list: In that case, let's go get first place!

text_block_list.text:
Now that she's won her debut race,
there's a much
greater variety of races
that Смарт Фалкон can
compete in.

If she places first in those races, she'll
naturally
attract more attention.
choice_data_list:
If we can win at least two races, I think people
will really start noticing you!

text_block_list.text: Okay! ☆ I just gotta win, then!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Let's make everybody remember the

up-and-coming Umadol, Falco! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
We set our sights on winning at least two
races at
the Pre-Open level или выше
during junior year to
jump-start Smart
Falcon's fame.
